name: Education as a Second Bachelor Degree

sections.title: Option A

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students in this option, who will have been admitted to the Professional Development Program, will complete a total of 60 upper division units in education.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Any additional course work needed to address academic requirements for a professional certificate and additional requirements to complete a minor must be completed over and above the required 60 upper division units.

sections.note: a minor from the Faculty of Education (see below)

sections.title: Option B

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students in this option, who will have been admitted to the Professional Linking Program, will complete a total of 48 upper division units in education.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Any additional course work needed to address academic requirements for a professional certificate and additional requirements to complete a minor must be completed over and above the required 48 upper division units.

sections.note: a minor from the Faculty of Education (see below)

sections.title: Option C

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Any additional course work needed to address academic requirements for a professional certificate and/or to complete a minor will be over and above the required courses noted below.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete all of the courses below, plus additional course work to meet their program requirements.

sections.note:
Students in this option, will have been admitted to the Professional Development Program.
One of the following minors from the Faculty of Education:
Social Justice in Education
Counselling and Human Development Minor Program
Curriculum and Instruction Minor Program
Early Learning Minor Program
Educational Psychology Minor Program
Elementary Generalist Minor Program
Environmental Education Minor Program
French Education Minor Program
International and Global Education Minor Program
Learning and Developmental Disabilities Minor Program
Physical and Health Education Minor Program
Secondary Mathematics Education Minor Program
Secondary Teaching Minor Program

sections.title: Teacher Regulation Branch Requirements
sections.note: It is the student's responsibility to ensure that they meet the Teacher Regulation Branch requirements for a Professional Teaching Certificate.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
